headline: American Airlines Launches New Chicago O'Hare to Tokyo Route
reasoning: This topic has high travel relevance as it directly impacts international travel options and airline competition. It's actionable for travelers planning future trips to Tokyo from Chicago, offering a new direct route, though the start date is a bit far out. Skift is a highly credible source for airline industry news.
summary: American Airlines will launch nonstop flights from Chicago O'Hare to Tokyo starting March 27, 2027, using a Boeing 787-9, as it aims to strengthen its international presence and compete with rivals.

source_articles.title: American Launches Flights to Tokyo From Chicago O’Hare as It Looks to Rebuild Hub and Take on United
source_articles.excerpt: American is launching flights to Tokyo from Chicago as it seeks to regain some of its market share in the hub that it lost during the pandemic.
